title: A linear dual-field finite element method for incompressible MHD, part I: cross-helicity and Alfvénic alignment in periodic domains
summary: Cross helicity, together with total energy, determines the Elsässer energies and thus quantifies departures from Alfvénic alignment in incompressible MHD. Building on the dual-field method in [Mao and Xi, \emph{J. Comput. Phys.}, 2025], we construct a linear finite element method for periodic domains that reproduces the cross-helicity balance. We connect the discrete energy and cross-helicity conservation laws to Alfvénic alignment through a nonnegative Elsässer-energy representation, establishing preservation of the corresponding exact relation when either Elsässer energy is initially zero…
